notes.expectedText: A supplied commit ID skips the update-checker branch and calls get_latest_release; exact release resolution remains delegated to an uninspected helper.
notes.message: Historical review context, manually carried forward after inference by checking exact text and retain lineage. The initial integrator disclosed replacing the wrong condition and leaving an overbroad exact-release sentence; the previous expansion removed that sentence without seeing review notes. This wave retains the narrower condition unchanged. Neither that retention nor prior wording changes verify the uninspected helper or automatically resolve the historical qualification. This is not a fresh source audit. Review notes were withheld from this wave's discovery and integration; the raw candidate graph is unchanged.
